narrative: Material PL1__MF297EB6 exhibits continuous high-volume demand averaging 1,227 units/day with moderate demand variability (CV=0.24). Lead times range from 0.43 to 5.97 working days with a CV of 57%, making supply unpredictability the dominant risk factor (93% of total safety stock variance). The current SAP safety stock of 1,223 units is insufficient for the 95% service level target; the recommended safety stock of 2,694 units addresses this gap. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy is adopted with EOQ-based order quantity of 10,709 units, well within the 18,907-unit storage capacity.
warnings: Lead time CV of 57% indicates high supply chain instability — investigate supplier reliability

research_insights.selected_model: (r,Q) continuous-review policy with EOQ order quantity
research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is continuous and high-volume (non-zero fraction = 100%, mean = 1,227 units/day), making a continuous-review (r,Q) policy appropriate. EOQ balances ordering and holding costs optimally for this volume. The MOQ of 94 units is non-binding as EOQ far exceeds it.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity of 18,907 units is not binding (SS + OQ = 13,403 units). However, if safety stock is further increased or order quantities grow, the capacity constraint could become active. No current service/cost degradation from capacity.
